items.title: Don Albert and Herbert Hall Interview, 1978-08-03

ctx.x: Well, he's still alive. I don't know the last I heard he was in the town. Oh, no. He's out now. He is in jail. No, no. He's the last I heard he was alive. That hasn't been too long.
Yeah, I saw it in the, uh... They gave his address and everything from the International Association of Jazz Record Collectors. Well, I told Benny Carter about it.
Uh... Let me see now. We're covering the country. You mentioned Ohio. Yeah, we played the whole state of Ohio. Kentucky? Most of the city's in Kentucky. That's in the, uh, Hill Country also.
